item.title: Drone attack in Iraq’s Erbil region kills 1, injures 7 French soldiers at military base
item.description: Officials say a drone strike hit a joint Peshmerga-French training site in the Makhmour area, wounding several French soldiers.

item.title: Israeli strike in Beirut kills two as missile attack injures 13 in northern Israel
item.description: Emergency services say 13 people were injured after a missile struck a building in Kiryat Tivon near Haifa.

item.title: Israeli army kills 4 Palestinians in Gaza, claims they crossed 'yellow line'
item.description: Killings come as Palestinian officials report continued Israeli strikes in Gaza despite ceasefire agreement reached in October 2025.

item.title: Pakistan launches fresh air strikes on Kabul and Afghan border provinces
item.description: Islamabad says the attacks targeted TTP militants, while Afghan Taliban says Pakistani strikes hit homes in Kabul and border provinces.

item.title: Trump threatens Iran following fresh attacks on Gulf states and Israel
item.description: Trump's threat comes as Iran launched a wave of new attacks on Gulf states on Friday.

item.title: Russia says global energy market needs its oil, piling pressure on US to lift sanctions
item.description: US temporarily allows sale of Russian oil at sea to boost supply and ease soaring energy prices.

item.title: Serbia preparing for possible attack by Croatia–Albania–Kosovo alliance, president says
item.description: The Serbian president says his country has Chinese hypersonic missiles with a range of up to 400 kilometres.

item.title: PM Sharif pledges Pakistan's 'full support' to Saudi Arabia
item.description: Pakistani premier meets Saudi crown prince Mohammed bin Salman in Jeddah as regional tensions rise after US-Israeli strikes on Iran.

item.title: Daily News Brief | 13 March
item.description: US military plane goes down in Iraq as Iran warns it could target regional oil infrastructure. And, US admits military unprepared to escort tankers through Strait of Hormuz... listen for more.

item.title: US has used 'years' worth of key munitions in Iran war, rapidly draining stockpiles: report
item.description: Heavy use of Tomahawk missiles and air defence systems is straining stockpiles as Pentagon prepares $50B funding request, a media report says.
